}\n84\t\n85\t        // Count unflushed beads\n86\t        let unflushed_count = count_unflushed(&db_path)?;\n87\t        result.unflushed_count = unflushed_count;\n88\t\n89\t        if unflushed_count > 0 {\n90\t            issues.push(format!(\n91\t                \"{} unflushed bead(s) exist (modified or created since last flush to JSONL)\",\n92\t                unflushed_count\n93\t            ));\n94\t        }\n95\t    }\n96\t\n97\t    result.db_ok = db_ok;\n98\t    result.jsonl_ok = jsonl_ok;\n99\t    result.issues = issues;\n100\t\n101\t    Ok(result)\n102\t}\n103\t\n104\t/// Check database integrity.\n105\tfn check_database(db_path: &Path) -> Result<(usize, bool)> {\n106\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n107\t\n108\t    // name='issues'\",\n112\t            [],\n113\t            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0),\n114\t        )\n115\t        .map(|n| n == 0)\n116\t        .unwrap_or(true);\n117\t    if needs_schema {\n118\t        crate::storage::schema::apply_schema(&conn)?;\n119\t    }\n120\t\n121\t    // Run PRAGMA integrity_check\n122\t    let integrity_result: String =\n123\t        conn.query_row(\"PRAGMA \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE deleted_at IS NULL\",\n130\t        [],\n131\t        |row| row.get(0),\n132\t    )?;\n133\t\n134\t    Ok((count as usize, integrity_ok))\n135\t}\n136\t\n137\t/// Check JSONL file validity.\n138\tfn check_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<(usize, bool)> {\n139\t    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n140\t        return Ok((0, true)); // Empty workspace is valid\n141\t    }\n142\t\n143\t    let mut count = 0;\n144\t    let mut valid = true;\n145\t\n146\t    match stream_issues(jsonl_path) {\n147\t        Ok(iter) => {\n148\t            for result in iter {\n149\t                match result {\n150\t                    Ok(_) => count += 1,\n151\t                    Err(e) => {\n152\t                        valid = false;\n153\t                        eprintln!(\"Invalid JSONL line: {}\", e);\n154\t                    }\n155\t                }\n156\t            }\n157\t        }\n158\t        Err(e) => {\n159\t            return Err(anyhow!(\"Failed to read JSONL file: {}\", e));\n160\t        }\n161\t    }\n162\t\n163\t    Ok((count, valid))\n164\t}\n165\t\n166\t/// Consistency drift details.\n167\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\n168\tstruct ConsistencyDrift {\n169\t    /// Bead IDs that exist in SQLite but not in JSONL\n170\t    missing_in_jsonl: Vec<String>,\n171\t    /// Bead IDs that exist in JSONL but not in SQLite\n172\t    missing_in_sqlite: Vec<String>,\n173\t    /// Bead IDs where content_hash differs between JSONL and SQLite\n174\t    hash_mismatch: Vec<String>,\n175\t}\n176\t\n177\t/// Check consistency between database and JSONL using content_hash.\n178\t///\n179\t/// Compares each bead's content_hash between JSONL and SQLite to detect drift.\n180\tfn check_consistency_with_hash(db_path: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ConsistencyDrift> {\n181\t    use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\n182\t\n183\t    let storage = Storage::open(db_path)?;\n184\t\n185\t    // Build a map of all SQLite issues with their content_hash\n186\t    let sqlite_issues: HashMap<String, String> = storage\n187\t        .list_all_issues()?\n188\t        .into_iter()\n189\t        .map(|issue| {\n190\t            let hash = issue.content_hash();\n191\t            (issue.id, hash)\n192\t        })\n193\t        .collect();\n194\t\n195\t    let mut drift = ConsistencyDrift::default();\n196\t    let mut jsonl_seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n197\t\n198\t    // Stream JSONL and compare, tracking seen IDs\n199\t    if jsonl_path.exists() {\n200\t        let iter = stream_issues(jsonl_path)?;\n201\t        for result in iter {\n202\t            let jsonl_issue = result?;\n203\t            let jsonl_hash = jsonl_issue.content_hash();\n204\t            let bead_id = jsonl_issue.id.clone();\n205\t            jsonl_seen.insert(bead_id.clone());\n206\t\n207\t            match sqlite_issues.get(&bead_id) {\n208\t                Some(sqlite_hash) => {\n209\t                    if sqlite_hash != &jsonl_hash {\n210\t                        drift.hash_mismatch.push(bead_id);\n211\t                    }\n212\t                }\n213\t                None => {\n214\t                    drift.missing_in_sqlite.push(bead_id);\n215\t                }\n216\t            }\n217\t        }\n218\t    }\n219\t\n220\t    // Find beads in SQLite but not in JSONL (using tracked seen IDs)\n221\t    for bead_id in sqlite_issues.keys() {\n222\t        if !jsonl_seen.contains(bead_id) {\n223\t            drift.missing_in_jsonl.push(bead_id.clone());\n224\t        }\n225\t    }\n226\t\n227\t    Ok(drift)\n228\t}\n229\t\n230\t/// Count unflushed beads (db-only or db-newer beads not yet flushed to JSONL).\n231\t///\n232\t/// Returns the count of beads that exist in SQLite but have been marked as dirty\n233\t/// (modified or created since the last flush to JSONL).\n234\tfn count_unflushed(db_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n235\t    use rusqlite::Connection;\n236\t\n237\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n238\t\n239\t    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n240\t    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n241\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n242\t        [],\n243\t        |row| row.get(0),\n244\t    )?;\n245\t\n246\t    if table_exists == 0 {\n247\t        return Ok(0);\n248\t    }\n249\t\n250\t    let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\n251\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dirty_issues\",\n252\t        [],\n253\t        |row| row.get(0),\n254\t    )?;\n255\t\n256\t    Ok(count as usize)\n257\t}\n258\t\n259\t/// Get IDs of unflushed beads.\n260\t///\n261\t/// Returns a list of bead IDs that exist in SQLite but have been marked as dirty\n262\t/// (modified or created since the last flush to JSONL).\n263\tfn get_unflushed_ids(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n264\t    use rusqlite::Connection;\n265\t\n266\t    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n267\t\n268\t    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n269\t    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n270\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n271\t        [],\n272\t        |row| row.get(0),\n273\t    )?;\n274\t\n275\t    if table_exists == 0 {\n276\t        return Ok(Vec::new());\n277\t    }\n278\t\n279\t    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT issue_id FROM dirty_issues ORDER BY issue_id\")?;\n280\t    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n281\t\n282\t    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n283\t    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n284\t        ids.push(row.get(0)?);\n285\t    }\n286\t\n287\t    Ok(ids)\n288\t}\n289\t\n290\t/// Repair the database by rebuilding from JSONL.\n291\t///\n292\t/// This is the recovery operation when the database is corrupted or missing.\n293\t/// The JSONL file is the authoritative source of truth for repair.\n294\t///\n295\t/// # Arguments\n296\t/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n297\t/// * `flush_first` - If true, flush unflushed beads to JSONL before repairing\n298\t/// * `force` - If true, proceed even with unflushed beads (they will be lost)\n299\t///\n300\t/// # Returns\n301\t/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\n302\tpub fn repair(workspace_dir: &Path, flush_first: bool, force: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n303\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n304\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n305\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n306\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n307\t    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n308\t\n309\t    // Check if JSONL exists\n310\t    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n311\t        return Err(anyhow!(\n312\t            \"Cannot repair: JSONL file              if flush_first {\n326\t                    // Cannot flush from a corrupt database\n327\t                    return Err(anyhow!(\n328\t                        \"Cannot flush: database is recovered.\\n\\\n331\t                         Remove --flush-first to proceed with repair only.\"\n332\t                    ));\n333\t                }\n334\t                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n335\t                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n336\t                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n337\t                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n338\t                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from must export everything because repair will rebuild db from JSONL\n351\t            eprintln!(\"Flushing all beads to JSONL before repair (including {} unflushed)...\", unflushed_ids.len());\n352\t            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n353\t            let flushed = storage.sync_to_jsonl(&jsonl_path, false)?;\n354\t            eprintln!(\"Flushed {} bead(s) to JSONL\", flushed);\n355\t        } else if !force {\n356\t            // Refuse to proceed with unflushed beads\n357\t            return Err(anyhow!(\n358\t                \"Cannot repair: {} unflushed bead(s) exist ({}).\\n\\\n359\t                 Run 'bf doctor --repair --flush-first' to flush before repair,\\n\\\n360\t                 or 'bf doctor --repair --force' to proceed (these beads will be LOST).\\n\\\n361\t                 Unflushed beads: {}\",\n362\t                unflushed_ids.len(),\n363\t                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n364\t                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n365\t                } else {\n366\t                    format!(\n367\t                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n368\t                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n369\t                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n370\t                    )\n371\t                },\n372\t                unflushed_ids.join(\", \")\n373\t            ));\n374\t        } else {\n375\t            // Force mode: warn but proceed\n376\t            eprintln!(\n377\t                \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) will be LOST: {}\",\n378\t                unflushed_ids.len(),\n379\t                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n380\t                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n381\t                } else {\n382\t                    format!(\n383\t                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n384\t                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n385\t                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n386\t                    )\n387\t                }\n388\t            );\n389\t            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n390\t        }\n391\t    }\n392\t\n393\t    // Backup existing database if it exists\n394\t    if db_path.exists() {\n395\t        let backup_path = db_path.with_extension(&format!(\n396\t            \"db.backup.{}\",\n397\t            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")\n398\t        ));\n399\t        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n400\t        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n401\t    }\n402\t\n403\t    // Delete old database\n404\t    if db_path.exists() {\n405\t        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n406\t    }\n407\t\n408\t    // Create new database and import JSONL\n409\t    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n410\t\n411\t    let result = import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n412\t        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n413\t        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n414\t    })?;\n415\t\n416\t    // Rebuild blocked cache\n417\t    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n418\t\n419\t    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n420\t    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n421\t\n422\t    Ok(result.imported)\n423\t}\n424\t\n425\t/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n426\t///\n427\t/// This materialized view should be Provides health checking and recovery operations for bead databases,\n//! including corruption detection and JSONL-based repair.\n\nuse crate::config::{find_beads_dir, load_metadata};\nuse results.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct DoctorResult {\n    pub db_ok: bool,\n    pub jsonl_ok: bool,\n    pub jsonl_line_count: usize,\n    pub db_issue_count: usize,\n    pub issues: Vec<String>,\n    // Drift tracking\n    pub missing_in_jsonl: Vec<String>,\n    pub missing_in_sqlite: Vec<String>,\n    pub hash_mismatch: Vec<String>,\n    // Unflushed bead tracking (db-only or db-newer beads that haven't been flushed to JSONL)\n    pub unflushed_count: usize,\n}\n\n/// Perform a health check on the bead database and JSONL file.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(DoctorResult)` - Health check results\npub fn check(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<DoctorResult> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = mut result = DoctorResult::default();\n\n    // Check database\n    let (db_issue_count, db_integrity_ok) = check_database(&db_path)?;\n    result.db_issue_count = db_issue_count;\n    if !db_integrity_ok {\n        db_ok = false;\n        issues.push(\"Database integrity check failed\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Check JSONL file\n    let (jsonl_line_count, jsonl_valid) = check_jsonl(&jsonl_path)?;\n    result.jsonl_line_count = jsonl_line_count;\n    if !jsonl_valid {\n        jsonl_ok = false;\n        issues.push(\"JSONL file contains invalid lines\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Check consistency with content_hash comparison\n    if db_ok && jsonl_ok {\n        let drift = check_consistency_with_hash(&db_path, &jsonl_path)?;\n\n        let total_drift = drift.missing_in_jsonl.len()\n            + drift.missing_in_sqlite.len()\n            + drift.hash_mismatch.len();\n\n        result.missing_in_jsonl = drift.missing_in_jsonl.clone();\n        result.missing_in_sqlite = drift.missing_in_sqlite.clone();\n        result.hash_mismatch = drift.hash_mismatch.clone();\n\n        if total_drift > 0 {\n            issues.push(format!(\n                \"Drift detected: {} missing in JSONL, {} missing in SQLite, {} hash mismatch\",\n                result.missing_in_jsonl.len(),\n                result.missing_in_sqlite.len(),\n                result.hash_mismatch.len()\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // Count unflushed beads\n        let unflushed_count = count_unflushed(&db_path)?;\n        result.unflushed_count = unflushed_count;\n\n        if unflushed_count > 0 {\n            issues.push(format!(\n                \"{} unflushed bead(s) exist (modified or created since last flush to JSONL)\",\n                unflushed_count\n            ));\n        }\n    }\n\n    result.db_ok = db_ok;\n    result.jsonl_ok = jsonl_ok;\n    result.issues = issues;\n\n    Ok(result)\n}\n\n/// Check database integrity.\nfn check_database(db_path: &Path) -> Result<(usize, bool)> {\n    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Apply schema if database is new (no tables yet)\n    let needs_schema: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='issues'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0),\n        )\n        .map(|n| n == 0)\n        .unwrap_or(true);\n    if needs_schema {\n        crate::storage::schema::apply_schema(&conn)?;\n    }\n\n    // Run PRAGMA integrity_check\n    let integrity_result: String =\n        conn.query_row(\"PRAGMA integrity_check\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n\n    let integrity_ok = integrity_result == \"ok\";\n\n    // Count issues\n    let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    Ok((count as usize, integrity_ok))\n}\n\n/// Check JSONL file validity.\nfn check_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<(usize, bool)> {\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Ok((0, true)); // Empty workspace is valid\n    }\n\n    let mut count = 0;\n    let mut valid = true;\n\n    match stream_issues(jsonl_path) {\n        Ok(iter) => {\n            for result in iter {\n                match result {\n                    Ok(_) => count += 1,\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        valid = false;\n                        eprintln!(\"Invalid JSONL line: {}\", e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"Failed to read JSONL file: {}\", e));\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok((count, valid))\n}\n\n/// Consistency drift details.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\nstruct ConsistencyDrift {\n    /// Bead IDs that exist in SQLite but not in JSONL\n    missing_in_jsonl: Vec<String>,\n    /// Bead IDs that exist in JSONL but not in SQLite\n    missing_in_sqlite: Vec<String>,\n    /// Bead IDs where content_hash differs between JSONL and SQLite\n    hash_mismatch: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// Check consistency between database and JSONL using content_hash.\n///\n/// Compares each bead's content_hash between JSONL and SQLite to detect drift.\nfn check_consistency_with_hash(db_path: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ConsistencyDrift> {\n    use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Build a map of all SQLite issues with their content_hash\n    let sqlite_issues: HashMap<String, String> = storage\n        .list_all_issues()?\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|issue| {\n            let hash = issue.content_hash();\n            (issue.id, hash)\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    let mut drift = ConsistencyDrift::default();\n    let mut jsonl_seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n\n    // Stream JSONL and compare, tracking seen IDs\n    if jsonl_path.exists() {\n        let iter = stream_issues(jsonl_path)?;\n        for result in iter {\n            let jsonl_issue = result?;\n            let jsonl_hash = jsonl_issue.content_hash();\n            let bead_id = jsonl_issue.id.clone();\n            jsonl_seen.insert(bead_id.clone());\n\n            match sqlite_issues.get(&bead_id) {\n                Some(sqlite_hash) => {\n                    if sqlite_hash != &jsonl_hash {\n                        drift.hash_mismatch.push(bead_id);\n                    }\n                }\n                None => {\n                    drift.missing_in_sqlite.push(bead_id);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Find beads in SQLite but not in JSONL (using tracked seen IDs)\n    for bead_id in sqlite_issues.keys() {\n        if !jsonl_seen.contains(bead_id) {\n            drift.missing_in_jsonl.push(bead_id.clone());\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(drift)\n}\n\n/// Count unflushed beads (db-only or db-newer beads not yet flushed to JSONL).\n///\n/// Returns the count of beads that exist in SQLite but have been marked as dirty\n/// (modified or created since the last flush to JSONL).\nfn count_unflushed(db_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    use rusqlite::Connection;\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if table_exists == 0 {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dirty_issues\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(count as usize)\n}\n\n/// Get IDs of unflushed beads.\n///\n/// Returns a list of bead IDs that exist in SQLite but have been marked as dirty\n/// (modified or created since the last flush to JSONL).\nfn get_unflushed_ids(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n    use rusqlite::Connection;\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if table_exists == 0 {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT issue_id FROM dirty_issues ORDER BY issue_id\")?;\n    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n\n    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n        ids.push(row.get(0)?);\n    }\n\n    Ok(ids)\n}\n\n/// Repair the database by rebuilding from JSONL.\n///\n/// This is the recovery operation when the database is corrupted or missing.\n/// The JSONL file is the authoritative source of truth for repair.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `flush_first` - If true, flush unflushed beads to JSONL before repairing\n/// * `force` - If true, proceed even with unflushed beads (they will be lost)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn repair(workspace_dir: &Path, flush_first: bool, force: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Cannot repair: JSONL file not found at {}\",\n            jsonl_path.display()\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Check for unflushed beads if database exists and is valid\n    // If db is corrupted, we can't detect unflushed beads - proceed with warning\n    let (unflushed_ids, db_corrupted) = if db_path.exists() {\n        match get_unflushed_ids(&db_path) {\n            Ok(ids) => (ids, false),\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Database is corrupted or unreadable\n                // We can't detect unflushed beads, so proceed with a warning\n                if flush_first {\n                    // Cannot flush from a corrupt database\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Cannot flush: database is corrupted and unreadable.\\n\\\n                         Flushing from a corrupt DB would poison the JSONL checkpoint.\\n\\\n                         Unflushed beads cannot be recovered.\\n\\\n                         Remove --flush-first to proceed with repair only.\"\n                    ));\n                }\n                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from JSONL...\");\n                (Vec::new(), true)\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // DB doesn't exist - no unflushed beads possible\n        (Vec::new(), false)\n    };\n\n    if !unflushed_ids.is_empty() {\n        if flush_first {\n            // Flush ALL beads to JSONL first (not just dirty ones)\n            // We must export everything because repair will rebuild db from JSONL\n            eprintln!(\"Flushing all beads to JSONL before repair (including {} unflushed)...\", unflushed_ids.len());\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let flushed = storage.sync_to_jsonl(&jsonl_path, false)?;\n            eprintln!(\"Flushed {} bead(s) to JSONL\", flushed);\n        } else if !force {\n            // Refuse to proceed with unflushed beads\n            return Err(anyhow!(\n                \"Cannot repair: {} unflushed bead(s) exist ({}).\\n\\\n                 Run 'bf doctor --repair --flush-first' to flush before repair,\\n\\\n                 or 'bf doctor --repair --force' to proceed (these beads will be LOST).\\n\\\n                 Unflushed beads: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                },\n                unflushed_ids.join(\", \")\n            ));\n        } else {\n            // Force mode: warn but proceed\n            eprintln!(\n                \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) will be LOST: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                }\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Backup existing database if it exists\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        let backup_path = db_path.with_extension(&format!(\n            \"db.backup.{}\",\n            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")\n        ));\n        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Delete old database\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n///\n/// This materialized view should be rebuilt after dependency or status changes.\npub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n///\n/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n/// back to open status.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes (default from config is 30)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads reclaimed\npub fn reclaim_stale(workspace_dir: &Path, ttl_minutes: i64) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::minutes(ttl_minutes);\n\n        let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n            \"UPDATE issues\n             SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n        )?;\n\n        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n    })?;\n\n    Ok(reclaimed)\n}\n\n/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n///\n/// Use this to create a fresh database from a JSONL export without\n/// affecting the existing database.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"JSONL file not found at {}\", jsonl_path.display()));\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Verify database schema version.\n///\n/// Checks that all required tables and indexes exist.\npub fn verify_schema(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Check for critical tables\n    let tables = [\n        \"issues\",\n        \"dependencies\",\n        \"labels\",\n        \"comments\",\n        \"events\",\n        \"config\",\n        \"metadata\",\n        \"dirty_issues\",\n        \"export_hashes\",\n        \"blocked_issues_cache\",\n        \"child_counters\",\n    ];\n\n    for table in &tables {\n        let exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?1\",\n            &[table],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n\n        if exists == 0 {\n            eprintln!(\"Missing table: {}\", table);\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use Sync protocol for bead-forge.\n//!\n//! Implements flush (SQLite → JSONL) and import (JSONL → SQLite) operations\n//! for git-backed bead synchronization.\n\nuse crate::config::{find_beads_dir, load_metadata};\nuse crate::jsonl::{export_jsonl, export_jsonl_dirty, import_jsonl, UpsertResult};\nuse crate::model::Issue;\nuse crate::storage::Storage;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\n/// Sync operation results.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct SyncResult {\n    pub imported: usize,\n    pub exported: usize,\n    pub updated: usize,\n    pub skipped: usize,\n}\n\n/// Flush all beads from SQLite to JSONL.\n///\n/// This is the primary export operation for git commit. Exports all beads\n/// sorted by ID for stable diffs.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads exported\npub fn flush(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Get all issues for export\n    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;\n\n    // Export to JSONL with atomic temp+rename\n    let result = export_jsonl(&jsonl_path, || Ok(issues.clone()))?;\n\n    // Update export_hashes for all exported issues\n    update_export_hashes_for_issues(&storage, &issues)?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - all beads have been flushed to JSONL\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.count)\n}\n\n/// Flush only dirty beads from SQLite to JSONL.\n///\n/// Incremental export for faster sync on large workspaces. Only exports\n/// beads that have been modified since the last flush.\n///\n/// NOTE: This function exports ONLY dirty beads to the JSONL file, replacing\n/// its contents. For a full export of all beads, use `flush()` instead.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads exported\npub fn flush_dirty(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Get dirty issues for export\n    let dirty_issues = storage.list_dirty_issues()?;\n    if dirty_issues.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    // Export to JSONL with atomic temp+rename (only dirty issues)\n    let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n        &jsonl_path,\n        || Ok(dirty_issues.clone()),\n        || storage.clear_dirty(),\n    )?;\n\n    // Update export_hashes for dirty issues only\n    update_export_hashes_for_issues(&storage, &dirty_issues)?;\n\n    Ok(result.count)\n}\n\n/// Import beads from JSONL into SQLite.\n///\n/// Compares each bead in JSONL with SQLite state using content_hash.\n/// INSERTs new beads, UPDATEs changed beads, SKIPs unchanged beads.\n///\n/// Collision resolution: when both JSONL and SQLite have changes for the\n/// same bead, the one with the later `updated_at` timestamp wins.\n///\n/// NOTE: If there are unflushed beads (db-only or db-newer), this function\n/// will emit a warning but proceed. The collision resolution logic preserves\n/// SQLite versions when they are newer, so unflushed beads are protected.\n/// Run `bf sync --flush-only` first to silence the warning.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(SyncResult)` - Import statistics\npub fn import(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<SyncResult> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir).ok_or_else(|| {\n        anyhow::anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display())\n    })?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Check for unflushed beads and warn\n    let dirty_issues = storage.list_dirty_issues()?;\n    if !dirty_issues.is_empty() {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) exist in SQLite (modified/created since last flush to JSONL).\",\n            dirty_issues.len()\n        );\n        eprintln!(\"  Import will preserve SQLite versions when they are newer.\");\n        eprintln!(\"  Run 'bf sync --flush-only' first to flush these beads to JSONL.\");\n        let dirty_ids: Vec<String> = dirty_issues.iter().map(|i| i.id.clone()).collect();\n        if dirty_ids.len() <= 5 {\n            eprintln!(\"  Unflushed: {}\", dirty_ids.join(\", \"));\n        } else {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"  Unflushed: {}, ... and {} more\",\n                dirty_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                dirty_ids.len() - 5\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Stream import with content_hash comparison\n    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n            let incoming_hash = issue.content_hash();\n            let existing = Storage::get_issue_tx(tx, &issue.id)?;\n\n            match existing {\n                None => {\n                    // New bead - insert\n                    Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n                    Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                }\n                Some(existing_issue) => {\n                    let existing_hash = existing_issue.content_hash();\n\n                    if incoming_hash == existing_hash {\n                        // Content unchanged - skip\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                    } else {\n                        // Content changed - use deterministic collision resolution\n                        // The bead with the later updated_at wins\n                        if issue.updated_at > existing_issue.updated_at {\n                            Storage::update_issue_from_json_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            // SQLite version is newer - skip JSONL version\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        })\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache after import\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    // Beads that were created/updated during import are now flushed to JSONL\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(SyncResult {\n        imported: result.imported,\n        exported: 0,\n        updated: result.updated,\n        skipped: result.skipped,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Full sync: import then flush.\n///\n/// Performs both import and flush operations. Use this when you want to\n/// ensure bidirectional synchronization.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(SyncResult)` - Sync statistics\npub fn sync(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<SyncResult> {\n    let import_result = import(workspace_dir)?;\n    let exported = flush(workspace_dir)?;\n\n &Storage, issues: &[Issue]) -> Result<()> {\n    storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n\n        for issue in issues {\n            let hash = Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn repair(workspace_dir: &Path, flush_first: bool, force: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n with warning\n    let (unflushed_ids, db_corrupted) = if db_path.exists() {\n        match get_unflushed_ids(&db_path) {\n            Ok(ids) => (ids, false),\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Database is corrupted or unreadable\n                // We can't detect unflushed beads, so proceed with a warning\n                if flush_first {\n                    // Cannot flush from a corrupt database\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Cannot flush: database is corrupted and unreadable.\\n\\\n                         Flushing from a corrupt DB would poison the JSONL checkpoint.\\n\\\n                         Unflushed beads cannot be recovered.\\n\\\n                         Remove --flush-first to proceed with repair only.\"\n                    ));\n                }\n                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from JSONL...\");\n                (Vec::new(), true)\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // DB doesn't exist - no unflushed beads possible\n        (Vec::new(), false)\n    };\n\n    if !unflushed_ids.is_empty() {\n        if flush_first {\n            // Flush ALL beads to JSONL first (not just dirty ones)\n            // We must export everything because repair will rebuild db from JSONL\n            eprintln!(\"Flushing all beads to JSONL before repair (including {} unflushed)...\", unflushed_ids.len());\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let flushed = storage.sync_to_jsonl(&jsonl_path, false)?;\n            eprintln!(\"Flushed {} bead(s) to JSONL\", flushed);\n        } else if !force {\n            // Refuse to proceed with unflushed beads\n            return Err(anyhow!(\n                \"Cannot repair: {} unflushed bead(s) exist ({}).\\n\\\n                 Run 'bf doctor --repair --flush-first' to flush before repair,\\n\\\n                 or 'bf doctor --repair --force' to proceed (these beads will be LOST).\\n\\\n                 Unflushed beads: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                },\n                unflushed_ids.join(\", \")\n            ));\n        } else {\n            // Force mode: warn but proceed\n            eprintln!(\n                \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) will be LOST: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                }\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Backup existing database if it exists\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        let backup_path = db_path.with_extension(&format!(\n            \"db.backup.{}\",\n            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")\n        ));\n        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Delete old database\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n///\n/// This materialized view should be rebuilt after dependency or status changes.\npub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n///\n/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n/// back to open status.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes (default from config is 30)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads reclaimed\npub fn reclaim_stale(workspace_dir: &Path, ttl_minutes: i64) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::minutes(ttl_minutes);\n\n        let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n            \"UPDATE issues\n             SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n        )?;\n\n        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n    })?;\n\n    Ok(reclaimed)\n}\n\n/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n///\n/// Use this to create a fresh database from a JSONL export without\n/// affecting the existing database.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"JSONL file not found at {}\", jsonl_path.display()));\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Verify database schema version.\n///\n/// Checks that all required tables and indexes exist.\npub fn verify_schema(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Check for critical tables\n    let tables = [\n        \"issues\",\n        \"dependencies\",\n        \"labels\",\n        \"comments\",\n        \"events\",\n        \"config\",\n        \"metadata\",\n        \"dirty_issues\",\n        \"export_hashes\",\n        \"blocked_issues_cache\",\n        \"child_counters\",\n    ];\n\n    for table in &tables {\n        let exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?1\",\n            &[table],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n\n        if exists == 0 {\n            eprintln!(\"Missing table: {}\", table);\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use JSONL).\nfn count_unflushed(db_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    use rusqlite::Connection;\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if table_exists == 0 {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dirty_issues\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(count as usize)\n}\n\n/// Get IDs of unflushed beads.\n///\n/// Returns a list of bead IDs that exist in SQLite but have been marked as dirty\n/// (modified or created since the last flush to JSONL).\nfn get_unflushed_ids(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n    use rusqlite::Connection;\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(db_path)?;\n\n    // Check if dirty_issues table exists\n    let table_exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dirty_issues'\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if table_exists == 0 {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT issue_id FROM dirty_issues ORDER BY issue_id\")?;\n    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n\n    let mut ids = Vec::new();\n    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n        ids.push(row.get(0)?);\n    }\n\n    Ok(ids)\n}\n\n/// Repair the database by rebuilding from JSONL.\n///\n/// This is the recovery operation when the database is corrupted or missing.\n/// The JSONL file is the authoritative source of truth for repair.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `flush_first` - If true, flush unflushed beads to JSONL before repairing\n/// * `force` - If true, proceed even with unflushed beads (they will be lost)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn repair(workspace_dir: &Path, flush_first: bool, force: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Cannot repair: JSONL file not found at {}\",\n            jsonl_path.display()\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Check for unflushed beads if database exists and is valid\n    // If db is corrupted, we can't detect unflushed beads - proceed with warning\n    let (unflushed_ids, db_corrupted) = if db_path.exists() {\n        match get_unflushed_ids(&db_path) {\n            Ok(ids) => (ids, false),\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Database is corrupted or unreadable\n                // We can't detect unflushed beads, so proceed with a warning\n                if flush_first {\n                    // Cannot flush from a corrupt database\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Cannot flush: database is corrupted and unreadable.\\n\\\n                         Flushing from a corrupt DB would poison the JSONL checkpoint.\\n\\\n                         Unflushed beads cannot be recovered.\\n\\\n                         Remove --flush-first to proceed with repair only.\"\n                    ));\n                }\n                // Proceed without unflushed check (db is unreadable)\n                // No --force needed since we can't detect unflushed beads anyway\n                eprintln!(\"WARNING: Database is corrupted and unreadable.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Cannot detect unflushed beads - any db-only beads will be lost.\");\n                eprintln!(\"  Proceeding with repair from JSONL...\");\n                (Vec::new(), true)\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // DB doesn't exist - no unflushed beads possible\n        (Vec::new(), false)\n    };\n\n    if !unflushed_ids.is_empty() {\n        if flush_first {\n            // Flush ALL beads to JSONL first (not just dirty ones)\n            // We must export everything because repair will rebuild db from JSONL\n            eprintln!(\"Flushing all beads to JSONL before repair (including {} unflushed)...\", unflushed_ids.len());\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let flushed = storage.sync_to_jsonl(&jsonl_path, false)?;\n            eprintln!(\"Flushed {} bead(s) to JSONL\", flushed);\n        } else if !force {\n            // Refuse to proceed with unflushed beads\n            return Err(anyhow!(\n                \"Cannot repair: {} unflushed bead(s) exist ({}).\\n\\\n                 Run 'bf doctor --repair --flush-first' to flush before repair,\\n\\\n                 or 'bf doctor --repair --force' to proceed (these beads will be LOST).\\n\\\n                 Unflushed beads: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                },\n                unflushed_ids.join(\", \")\n            ));\n        } else {\n            // Force mode: warn but proceed\n            eprintln!(\n                \"WARNING: {} unflushed bead(s) will be LOST: {}\",\n                unflushed_ids.len(),\n                if unflushed_ids.len() <= 5 {\n                    unflushed_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\", \")\n                } else {\n                    format!(\n                        \"{}, ... and {} more\",\n                        unflushed_ids[..5].join(\", \"),\n                        unflushed_ids.len() - 5\n                    )\n                }\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Proceeding with repair due to --force flag\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Backup existing database if it exists\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        let backup_path = db_path.with_extension(&format!(\n            \"db.backup.{}\",\n            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d%H%M%S\")\n        ));\n        std::fs::copy(&db_path, &backup_path)?;\n        eprintln!(\"Backed up existing database to {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Delete old database\n    if db_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::remove_file(&db_path)?;\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        import_jsonl(&jsonl_path, |issue| {\n            Storage::create_issue_tx(tx, &issue)?;\n            Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n        })\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after rebuild from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    // (create_issue_tx doesn't mark dirty, but we clear for safety)\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Rebuild the blocked issues cache.\n///\n/// This materialized view should be rebuilt after dependency or status changes.\npub fn rebuild_cache(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Reclaim stale in_progress beads.\n///\n/// Resets beads that have been in_progress for longer than the TTL\n/// back to open status.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes (default from config is 30)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads reclaimed\npub fn reclaim_stale(workspace_dir: &Path, ttl_minutes: i64) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let reclaimed = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        let stale_cutoff = chrono::Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::minutes(ttl_minutes);\n\n        let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n            \"UPDATE issues\n             SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n             WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND updated_at < ?\",\n            rusqlite::params![chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n        )?;\n\n        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(reclaimed)\n    })?;\n\n    Ok(reclaimed)\n}\n\n/// Initialize a new database from an existing JSONL file.\n///\n/// Use this to create a fresh database from a JSONL export without\n/// affecting the existing database.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_dir` - Path to the workspace root (contains .beads/)\n/// * `jsonl_path` - Path to the JSONL file to import from\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(usize)` - Number of beads imported\npub fn init_from_jsonl(workspace_dir: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<usize> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    // Check if JSONL exists\n    if !jsonl_path.exists() {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"JSONL file not found at {}\", jsonl_path.display()));\n    }\n\n    // Create new database and import JSONL\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let result = import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n        storage.create_issue(issue)?;\n        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n    })?;\n\n    // Rebuild blocked cache\n    storage.rebuild_blocked_cache()?;\n\n    // Clear dirty marks - after import from JSONL, db and JSONL are in sync\n    storage.clear_dirty()?;\n\n    Ok(result.imported)\n}\n\n/// Verify database schema version.\n///\n/// Checks that all required tables and indexes exist.\npub fn verify_schema(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool> {\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace_dir)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {}\", workspace_dir.display()))?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n    let conn = Connection::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Check for critical tables\n    let tables = [\n        \"issues\",\n        \"dependencies\",\n        \"labels\",\n        \"comments\",\n        \"events\",\n        \"config\",\n        \"metadata\",\n        \"dirty_issues\",\n        \"export_hashes\",\n        \"blocked_issues_cache\",\n        \"child_counters\",\n    ];\n\n    for table in &tables {\n        let exists: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?1\",\n            &[table],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n\n        if exists == 0 {\n            eprintln!(\"Missing table: {}\", table);\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use
